n: Autograph Edition 36 In. 4.6 Cu. Ft. Legacy Dual Fuel Range With 6 Burner Gas Cooktop And Electric Convection Oven In Black Stainless Steel And Champagne Bronze Accents
desc: The ZLINE Autograph Edition 36 in. 4.6 cu. ft. Legacy Dual Fuel Range with 6 Burner Gas Cooktop and Electric Convection Oven in Black Stainless Steel and Champagne Bronze Accents (RABZ-36-CB) pairs a powerful gas cooktop with 6 Italian-crafted burners, an electric convection oven with a Landscape oven door window design, and elegant champagne bronze knobs and handle. With innovative features designed to enhance your kitchen’s capability, ZLINE Legacy Dual Fuel Ranges provide a professional culinary experience by pairing unmatched performance with timeless style.
hl: The Legacy Professional Range Series represents the foundation for ZLINE’s family-focused mission of attainable luxury
Customize your ZLINE Autograph Edition Dual Fuel Range with elegant Champagne Bronze knob and handle accents
Optimize every meal with even heat distribution thanks to high-performance technology of a gas cooktop and an electric convection oven
Industry-leading gas cooktop includes 6 hand-cast burners with 1,000 - 18,000 BTUs of cooking power
ZLINE Legacy Series ranges feature a sleek Landscape oven door design that provides ample viewing space to ensure your dishes are perfectly cooked
A 4.6 cu. ft oven fits pans up to 27 in. wide for maximum space and convenience with everyday cooking
